messages:
Priya Shah: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: can leadership surface the primary failure modes for deals we lost this quarter? Looking for short, actionable causes we can assign.
Maya Chen: High-level: 1) missing compliance artifacts (SOC2/data residency), 2) perceived long-term TCO on heavy token workloads, 3) lack of model pinning/variant guarantees.
Samir Patel: Sales color: compliance stalls procurement 50%+ of the time with enterprise prospects; mid-market balks at commit length and unpredictable bills; some technical buyers prefer vendors who let them pin models or deliver fine-tunes.
Jin Park: Engineering notes: TCO complaints often track to p95 latency spikes and inefficient batching for long-context requests. We can mitigate with caching + better batching heuristics.
Leah O'Neill: CS observations: onboarding friction for Private (especially VPC) is a recurring theme. Customers ask for a step-by-step deploy checklist and a short "security get-ready" packet to hand to infosec.
Priya Shah: Can we map each cause to a suggested owner and a one-line acceptance criteria? Eg SOC2 -> Heather V (Security) -> audit signed; Onboarding packet -> Leah -> two customer confirmations.
Maya Chen: Suggested owners: SOC2 & data residency -> Rajiv Menon + Security; TCO/ops -> Jin Park + Eng Infra; Model pinning -> Nora Kim (Product); Onboarding packet -> Leah. Acceptance criteria as Priya suggested.
Samir Patel: For prioritization: SOC2 + onboarding packet likely unblock the biggest enterprise ARR. Pricing/commit experiments help mid-market but take longer to validate.
Jin Park: Short engineering plan: 1) quick wins (1-2 weeks): improved autoscaler cooldowns, better KV cache warmup docs; 2) medium (4-6 weeks): route-level batching refinements; 3) exploratory (quarter): quantized serving options to reduce cost.
Leah O'Neill: I'll run two Private deploy validations this week with customers and post notes. I'll also draft a 1-page security packet template for infosec reviewers.
Priya Shah: Can everyone paste one-line ETA + owner by EOD? I'll compile and share with the GTM leads.
ops-bot: Recording + notes: https://redwood.internal/records/allhands-2026-03-22-followup ; Roadmap update page: https://redwood.internal/roadmap/q2-update
Maya Chen: Love it. Let's reconvene in two weeks for owners' quick status updates and any numbers. :thumbsup:
